cohort: 230 primigravida females presenting in labor for delivery at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Unit-3, Jinnah Hospital, Lahore, from 20th January 2018 to 19th July 2018
finding: There was a significant association between cesarean section and unengaged fetal head in primigravida women.
gest_age: 38.4+/-1.2 weeks in the unengaged fetal head group and 38.3+/-1.1 weeks in the engaged fetal head group
